parsed.why: State adds broad public-facility ban on restrooms, changing and sleeping areas by birth sex, with a civil cause of action and no state gender-identity nondiscrimination or hate-crime law; universal visitor exposure below parent.

Only school-level facility restriction and care ban; no statewide adult bathroom rule. State lacks gender-identity hate-crime and accommodations protection, but visitor exposure is mainly national; modestly below parent.

Criminal misdemeanour for trans bathroom, locker or changing use where a minor is present, plus school ban and 'worst policies' tier; no state gender-identity protections. Strongest state-level exposure.
School facilities rule binds visitors to birth-certificate restrooms; gender identity removed from civil-rights law and localities barred from stronger protections; worst-policy group.

No bathroom ban; 2013 law bars gender-identity discrimination in public accommodations and hate-crime enhancement applies. State protective layer lifts it above parent, though national border and document regime remains.
